integrity: The claim is supported by a self-contained analytic proof and a supplementary deterministic exact finite checker. No independent evaluation or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for p congruent 3 modulo 8 on F_p^2 under the standard dot-product Fourier pairing; the p congruent 7 modulo 8 minimum and classification of all extremizers remain unproved.
title: Sharp four-point self-disjoint Fourier supports on \(\mathbb F_p^2\) for \(p\equiv3\pmod8\)
